name: Abimelech
summary: A son of Gideon who killed his seventy brothers to make himself king at Shechem. He reigned three years before God sent trouble between him and the men of Shechem, and he died at Thebez.

key_moments.title: Made King at Shechem
key_moments.description: Abimelech won over his mother's family at Shechem and used their silver to hire worthless men. He killed his brothers on one stone at Ophrah, and only the youngest, Jotham, escaped by hiding.

key_moments.title: Shechem Turns Against Him
key_moments.description: After three years God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem, and they rose against him. He took the city, sowed it with salt, and burned the tower where about a thousand men and women had fled.

key_moments.title: Struck by a Millstone
key_moments.description: As Abimelech came to burn the tower of Thebez, a woman threw a piece of millstone on his head. He told his armourbearer to kill him so no one would say a woman slew him.
